question: What is a key trade-off of adding an index to a table column?
options: It speeds up reads on that column but slows down writes and uses extra storage
It speeds up both reads and writes with no downside
It guarantees the column values are unique
It permanently sorts the underlying table on disk
explanation: An index accelerates lookups/filters on the column, but every INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE must also maintain the index, adding write cost and storage. Uniqueness needs a separate UNIQUE constraint.
